SPFEconomiePage.title: Business center approved by the SPF Economy
SPFEconomiePage.desc: For the legal security of your business, choose a partner fully compliant with Belgian law.
SPFEconomiePage.law_title: The Law of March 29, 2018: What it requires
SPFEconomiePage.law_p1_1: Since the entry into force of the
SPFEconomiePage.law_p1_2: on the registration of corporate service providers, any business center offering domiciliation of headquarters in Belgium has the
SPFEconomiePage.law_p1_b2: legal obligation to be registered and approved by the SPF Economy
SPFEconomiePage.law_p2: This strict regulation aims to fight fraud and guarantee entrepreneurs a high level of professionalism. The approval is only granted after a thorough verification of the provider's respectability and capability.
SPFEconomiePage.risk_desc: Domiciling your company in a center not recognized by the SPF Economy exposes you to major risks:
SPFEconomiePage.r1_d: Your company number may be deleted from the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises.
SPFEconomiePage.r2_d: Tax authorities can block your activity.
SPFEconomiePage.r3_d: Obligation to find a new headquarters urgently.
SPFEconomiePage.guarantee_desc: As an approved center, we assure you total peace of mind for the future of your company:
SPFEconomiePage.g1_d: Meets the requirements of all Belgian administrations.
SPFEconomiePage.g2_d: Reception and archiving in compliance with the rules.
SPFEconomiePage.g3_d: Regular audit of our processes and management by the State.
SPFEconomiePage.cta_title: Protect your business with a certified address
SPFEconomiePage.cta_desc: Take no legal risk for the future of your SME or freelance activity. Domicile with Office Factory today.
